_doc_architecture: Selects the git workflow preset. Supported: 'feature-based' (default), 'env-flow' (main/dev/qa/uat), 'gitflow', 'github-flow', 'gitlab-flow', 'trunk-based', 'monorepo'. See config-examples/env-flow.json for SNP-style env promotion.
_doc_branch_names: All branch name fields are OPTIONAL — unset fields inherit from the chosen architecture preset, which falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG. Only set fields that differ from the preset.
_doc_mainBranch: Canonical production branch. Used as the hotfix base in gitflow. Default: 'main'.
_doc_developBranch: Integration branch for in-progress work. gitflow: 'develop'. github-flow / gitlab-flow / trunk: same as mainBranch. Default: 'develop'.
_doc_devBranch: Dev-build integration branch (feature-based only). Feature branches open MRs here to trigger dev environment CI builds. Default: 'dev'.
_doc_stagingBranch: Staging environment branch (gitlab-flow only). Code promotes from mainBranch to stagingBranch via MR. Default: 'staging'.
_doc_productionBranch: Production environment branch (gitlab-flow only). Code promotes from stagingBranch here via MR. Default: 'production'.
_doc_qaBranch: QA environment branch (env-flow). Sprint fixbug MRs often target here. Default: 'qa'.
_doc_uatBranch: UAT / pre-production branch (env-flow). Hotfix and fixbug branches are created from here. Default: 'uat'.
_doc_additionalBranches: Optional extra long-lived branches, e.g. {"lts": "lts"}. Use with start-branch --from lts when needed.
_doc_branch_prefixes: Used by coolkit start-branch and finish-branch. Examples: feature/contract-management, fixbug/contract-management, hotfix/login-crash-fix, common/fix-validator-null-check.
_doc_fixbugBranchPrefix: Prefix for sprint fixbug branches (env-flow). 'fixbug' → 'fixbug/contract-management'. Default: 'fixbug'.
_doc_mrBranchPrefix: Prefix for safe MR branches created by git-create-mr --checkout. 'mr' → 'mr/feature-auth-20260526120000'. Default: 'mr'.
_doc_feature_based_section: The following fields are only meaningful when architecture = 'feature-based'.
_doc_featurePath: Path(s) treated as feature-specific source code. Anything OUTSIDE these paths is considered common/shared code and will be extracted by git-extract-common. Accepts a string or an array of strings.
_doc_commonExcludePaths: Directories excluded from the common-extract diff entirely. Use for: submodules, vendored packages, generated directories. Each entry excludes the directory root AND all its nested files.
_doc_commonExcludeFiles: Individual files excluded from the common-extract diff. Use for: build artifacts, version files, local-only config. Each entry excludes exactly one file (not its parent directory).
_doc_shared_section: The following fields apply to all architectures.
_doc_remote: Git remote name. Change if your remote is not named 'origin'. Default: 'origin'.
_doc_protectedBranches: Branches the CLI refuses to use as a source/feature branch. Prevents accidental destructive operations on integration branches.
_doc_mergeRequestProvider: MR/PR provider used by all commands that open merge requests. 'gitlab' → glab CLI. 'github' → gh CLI. 'none' → prints browser URL only. Default: 'gitlab'.
_doc_syncStrategy: Sync strategy used by coolkit sync-from-main. 'merge' creates a merge commit (safer, preserves history context). 'rebase' replays your commits on top of main (linear history, requires force-push). Default: 'merge'.
_doc_messageFormats: Template strings for auto-generated MR titles and commit messages. Use {placeholder} tokens — values are substituted at runtime. Unknown tokens are left as-is.
_doc_createMrTitleFormat: MR title for create-mr / finish-branch (direct push, no --checkout). Placeholders: {sourceBranch}, {targetBranch}, {mrBranch}, {timestamp}, {architecture}. Default: '{sourceBranch} → {targetBranch}'.
_doc_createMrTitleCheckoutFormat: MR title for create-mr --checkout (safe MR branch). Same placeholders as createMrTitleFormat. Default: '[{sourceBranch}] → {targetBranch}'.
_doc_extractCommonMrTitleFormat: MR title for extract-common. Placeholders: {featureBranch}, {commonBranch}, {mainBranch}, {timestamp}, {fileCount}. Default: '[{featureBranch}] common → {mainBranch} ({timestamp})'.
_doc_extractCommonCommitSubjectFormat: Commit subject (first line) for extract-common. Same placeholders as extractCommonMrTitleFormat. Default: 'common: extract from {featureBranch} ({timestamp})'.
_doc_extractCommonMainMergeFormat: Suggested merge commit when merging common MR into main. Same placeholders. Default: 'common: merge shared changes from {featureBranch} ({commonBranch} → {mainBranch})'.
_doc_branchFormats: Template strings for auto-generated branch names and backup tags. Use {placeholder} tokens.
_doc_commonBranchFormat: Common branch from extract-common. Use --desc for slug. Placeholders: {commonBranchPrefix}, {featureBranch}, {featureSlug}, {descSlug}, {timestamp}. env-flow default: '{commonBranchPrefix}/{descSlug}'.
_doc_mrBranchFormat: Safe MR branch from create-mr --checkout. Placeholders: {mrBranchPrefix}, {sourceBranch}, {sourceSlug}, {targetBranch}, {timestamp}. Default: '{mrBranchPrefix}/{sourceSlug}-{timestamp}'.
_doc_featureBranchFormat: Feature branch from start-branch --type feature. Placeholders: {featureBranchPrefix}, {name}, {nameSlug}. Default: '{featureBranchPrefix}/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_releaseBranchFormat: Release branch from start-branch --type release. Placeholders: {releaseBranchPrefix}, {name}, {nameSlug}. Default: '{releaseBranchPrefix}/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_hotfixBranchFormat: Hotfix branch from start-branch --type hotfix. Placeholders: {hotfixBranchPrefix}, {name}, {nameSlug}. Default: '{hotfixBranchPrefix}/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_fixBranchFormat: Fix branch from start-branch --type fix. Placeholders: {name}, {nameSlug}. Default: 'fix/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_choreBranchFormat: Chore branch from start-branch --type chore. Placeholders: {name}, {nameSlug}. Default: 'chore/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_syncBackupTagFormat: Backup tag before sync-from-main merge. Placeholders: {branch}, {branchSlug}, {timestamp}. Default: 'backup/{branchSlug}-{timestamp}'.
_doc_fixbugBranchFormat: fixbug branch from start-branch --type fixbug. Default: '{fixbugBranchPrefix}/{nameSlug}'.
_doc_commitMessageFormat: Conventional commit subject. Placeholders: {type}, {scope}, {ticketId}, {description}. Default: '{type}({scope}) {ticketId}: {description}'. Types: feat, fix, refactor, style, test, docs, chore, perf.
_doc_commitTypeByBranchPrefix: Default commit type per branch prefix. feature→feat, fixbug→fix, hotfix→fix, common→chore.
_doc_mrTargetByBranchPrefix: Default MR target per source prefix (env-flow). feature→dev, fixbug→qa, hotfix→uat, common→main.
_doc_baseBranchByBranchType: Base branch when running start-branch. feature→dev, fixbug→uat, hotfix→uat (env-flow defaults).
_doc_semverBumpByCommitType: Semver bump hint per commit type (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). feat→minor, fix→patch, refactor/style/test/docs/chore→none. Startup uses 0.x.x until production launch → 1.0.0.
